HediffDef.label: reflex booster
HediffDef.description: A spinal implant that reads and redirects momentum. It can drive its carrier's perception far ahead of the world's, seize the rounds flying near them and turn them, or throw an attacker away.

HediffDef.label: phase barrier
HediffDef.description: An archotech implant that repeatedly halves the remaining distance of anything approaching its user. It suspends attacks without destroying them and blocks air on the same terms.

HediffDef.label: neural accelerator
HediffDef.description: A brain implant that changes its user's internal rate of time. It can accelerate them to twice or four times normal speed, or slow them to one third.
